description: YouTube Shorts recommendation sequence — fixed window per call (no cursor), not a global chart. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 100). Returns a single window; use limit to size it. No cursor. Flat 2 credits per call.

q.description: Optional topic seed for the Shorts recommendation sequence. Omit (or pass trending/shorts) for the default reel feed — not a keyword search.

name: youtube_trending_shorts
